reasoning: Academic research and benchmark evaluations demonstrate that state-of-the-art AI language models, beginning with OpenAI's GPT-4, can successfully pass the Uniform Bar Examination (UBE). In evaluations conducted by Katz et al. (2023) and reported in OpenAI's technical documentation, GPT-4 achieved a score in the 90th percentile (top 10%), well above both the required passing threshold and the average human test-taker score.
title: AI systems now pass the bar exam
